On the other hand, although the focus of the course is the emerging markets,  we studied those as exceptions of theory. For example, we learned about the UIP condition, but we briefly mentioned the risk premium instead of elaborating and studying its dynamics (maybe with data).  This could be due to the textbook, which reflects that understanding of EMs is built on former theories. Regardless, some case studies and empirics that focus on EMs should be involved in lectures & assignments.
